description: This file defines an abstract base class for unit testing PDF-related functionalities within the PdfSharp library, including methods for creating PDFs, managing test contexts, and handling file operations.

classes.name: TestClassBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing utility methods and properties for unit testing PDF functionalities in the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: TestInstance
classes.description: A nested class managing individual test run instances, including start time and directory operations.

methods.name: CreateNewPdfDocument
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new PDF document with title and subject.

methods.name: CreatePdfPage
methods.description: Adds a new page to a PDF document with specified dimensions.

methods.name: TestSnippet
methods.description: Renders a code snippet as PDF and PNG, generates comparison documents, and manages directories.

methods.name: GetTestDocumentPath
methods.description: Constructs a full file path for a test document based on filename.

methods.name: TestDocumentsDirectory
methods.description: Property returning the directory path for test documents.

methods.name: SaveTestDocument
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a specified filepath and registers it in test results.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocument
methods.description: Saves a PDF document and optionally opens it in a viewer.

methods.name: ConcatPdfFiles
methods.description: Concatenates multiple PDF files into a single document.

methods.name: AddCurrentFilepath
methods.description: Adds a filepath to the list of current files and registers it in test results.

methods.name: GetAndRemoveFirstCurrentFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first filepath from the list of current files.
